name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 13 – Am 20
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 13a. Calls on the Member States, in accordance with EU and national law, to ensure that the active promotion of Islamist ideologies advocating the subjugation of women, antisemitism or hatred against Christians has appropriate legal and administrative consequences, including as regards access to public funding, public benefits and institutional support;
